description: This Java class handles serial port reading, including asynchronous data reading with sleep-based polling, event-based serial event handling, and initial buffer reading, for serial communication in the rusefi project.

classes.name: SerialPortReader
classes.description: A class that manages reading data from a serial port asynchronously, with support for event-driven and buffer-based reading.

methods.name: SerialPortReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serial port and listener, and starts a thread to read data continuously.

methods.name: progressiveSleepRead
methods.description: Reads bytes from the serial port with progressive sleep durations to handle Windows serial port quirks.

methods.name: serialEvent
methods.description: Handles serial port events, with some logic commented out for specific event types.

methods.name: readInitial
methods.description: Reads all data currently in the serial port input buffer at startup.

methods.name: getSerialPortEventListener
methods.description: Returns the serial port event listener instance.
